open_points.subject: register_work_payment
open_points.text: - register_work_payment: [BEHAVIOR] MUST validate the amount through validate_eur_amount with the portal currency, the imported MONEY_CURRENCY constant, and strictly_positive true before opening any transaction, so a FinancialValidationError changes nothing; payment_id is the replay identity: equal payment_id/content returns existing, conflict changes nothing, and a new payment plus the payment.register member of = models.AuditAction audit commits atomically without creating an invoice/accounting posting.
open_points.other_text: - register_work_payment: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST build the new = models.WorkPayment with the imported build_work_payment, passing the context, the supplied payment_id, payment_date and description, the validated amount and the single utc_now instant as now, and its audit intent with the imported build_project_audit_intent, passing the context, the payment.register member of = models.AuditAction, the WORK_PAYMENT member of = models.AuditEntityKind and the payment_id as entity_id.
open_points.question: The first passage names payment.register as the AuditAction member, while the changed passage and the declared enum surface require PAYMENT_REGISTER; change payment.register to PAYMENT_REGISTER in both passages or otherwise reconcile which enum member name must be used.

open_points.subject: set_section_progress
open_points.text: - set_section_progress: [BEHAVIOR] MUST validate the project section and completion percent as an integer from zero to the imported COMPLETION_PERCENT_MAX constant inclusive, upsert the manual value, and append the progress.update member of = models.AuditAction atomically; photographs MUST NOT alter it.
open_points.other_text: - set_section_progress: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST build the upserted = models.SectionProgress with the imported build_section_progress, passing the context, the section_id, the completion_percent _validate_completion_percent accepted and the single utc_now instant as now, and its audit intent with the imported build_project_audit_intent, passing the context, the progress.update member of = models.AuditAction, the SECTION_PROGRESS member of = models.AuditEntityKind and the section_id as entity_id.
open_points.question: The first passage names progress.update as the AuditAction member, while the changed passage and the declared enum surface require PROGRESS_UPDATE; change progress.update to PROGRESS_UPDATE in both passages or otherwise reconcile which enum member name must be used.
